applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Use Recipient Management → Add new recipient and choose the bank-account or HarborPay category. For a same-name bank recipient, select the same-name type and enter the actual account details.

Supported bank cards include debit, savings and corporate settlement cards. Credit cards and social-security cards are not supported recipients under this arrangement. For a personal customer, the same-name account belongs to the customer; for a company, it is the matching company bank account or the supported legal representative's account.

Find existing recipients under Recipient Management → All by account number, holder name or remark. A shared bank card does not establish whether Amazon will link two seller accounts; use the correct identity for each account and obtain the platform's requirements.

Mainland e-commerce accounts can hold up to 500 HarborPay recipients. Batch bank/HarborPay payments do not automatically add the recipients to Recipient Management. Successful VAT payments have a separate automatic-recipient-save behavior.

For a third-party company, its registration number and registered or business address are the recipient's details, not the payer's identity number.
